name: Example: platform health pipeline (everything)
description: The showcase job: it uses almost every feature at once. Every weekday morning (and after the rollup example succeeds) four checks run in parallel: splunkd errors, skipped scheduled searches, license usage and search activity. They merge into one table and a health score. The score is appended to so_example_platform_health.csv, and on Mondays a weekly trend reads it back (Run when). Three kinds of If… condition: a simple comparison against the error_threshold parameter drills into the worst components, a search condition explains skipped searches, and an SPL expression asks an admin to approve an escalation when the score is below 80. Approve writes an event to index=main; reject or a one-hour timeout notes the rejection. A summary runs either way. The job must finish by 07:30 (or within 90 minutes) or it emails as late; it also emails on failure, on a slow step and when approval is needed, and starts the hourly errors example when it succeeds. To page instead of email, add a Teams, PagerDuty or ServiceNow destination in Settings and swap an Email node for a Webhook node.

params.name: environment
params.label: Environment
params.description: Shown in the score and the approval message

params.name: error_threshold
params.label: Error threshold
params.description: Drill into components when splunkd logged at least this many errors

params.name: host_filter
params.label: Host filter
params.description: Limit the splunkd checks to hosts matching this (wildcards allowed)

steps.name: splunkd errors by component
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd log_level=ERROR host=$run.param.host_filter$
| stats count AS value BY component
| eval check="errors", name=component

steps.name: Skipped scheduled searches
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler status=skipped
| stats count AS value BY savedsearch_name
| eval check="skipped", name=savedsearch_name

steps.name: License usage by index (GB)
steps.spl:
index=_internal source=*license_usage.log* type=Usage
| stats sum(b) AS bytes BY idx
| eval value=round(bytes/1024/1024/1024, 3), check="license_gb", name=idx
| fields - bytes

steps.name: Searches per user
steps.spl:
index=_audit action=search info=completed
| stats count AS value BY user
| eval check="searches", name=user

steps.name: Merge all checks
steps.spl:
| table check name value
| sort check - value

steps.name: Health score
steps.spl:
| stats sum(eval(if(check="errors", value, 0))) AS errors sum(eval(if(check="skipped", value, 0))) AS skipped sum(eval(if(check="license_gb", value, 0))) AS license_gb dc(eval(if(check="searches", name, null()))) AS active_users
| eval score=max(0, 100 - min(50, round(errors/tonumber($run.param.error_threshold$)*10)) - min(30, skipped*2))
| eval env="$run.param.environment$", day=strftime(tonumber($run.scheduled_time$) - 86400, "%Y-%m-%d")

steps.name: Weekly trend (Mondays)
steps.spl:
| inputlookup so_example_platform_health.csv
| where strptime(day, "%Y-%m-%d") >= relative_time(tonumber($run.scheduled_time$), "-7d@d")
| stats avg(score) AS avg_score min(score) AS worst_score sum(errors) AS errors BY env

steps.name: Drill into the worst components
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd log_level=ERROR host=$run.param.host_filter$
| stats count AS errors latest(event_message) AS last_message BY component
| sort - errors
| head 10

steps.name: Why searches were skipped
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler status=skipped
| stats count BY savedsearch_name, reason
| sort - count

approval.message: Platform health score is $score.first.score$ in $run.param.environment$ ($score.first.errors$ errors, $score.first.skipped$ skipped searches). Open an incident?

steps.name: Note the rejection
steps.spl:
| makeresults
| eval note="escalation not approved", by="$approve_escalation.first.by|timeout$", score="$score.first.score$"
| table _time note by score

steps.name: Run summary either way
steps.spl:
| makeresults
| eval job="example_platform_health", env="$run.param.environment$", score_status="$score.status$", save_status="$save_history.status$"
| table _time job env score_status save_status

edges.expression:
index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler status=skipped
| stats count
| where count > 5
